errors.text_span: зелено за 2024 г. и сиво за 2025 г.
errors.evidence: The chart uses gray for 2024, and there is no data for 2025. The description incorrectly introduces a nonexistent year and misassigns colors.
The description does not explicitly state that the chart illustrates percentage values for three years (2022, 2023, 2024) across months.
The description does not mention the vertical axis label ('%') or its range (0,000 to 140,000).
The description does not mention the grouped structure of bars by month, which allows comparison between years.
The description does not highlight that December 2022 has the highest value (over 120,000) and July and December 2023 have the lowest values (80,000).
The chart only includes data for three years: 2022, 2023, and 2024. The mention of 2025 is fabricated.
